releases.title: Recorded overlays during playback
changes: Show recorded tags, floor heights and measurements over saved video on the device.
Keep overlays aligned while playing, pausing, seeking and rotating; toggle them off to inspect the clean video.
Preserve the clean MP4 and original sensor data for sharing and later processing.

releases.title: Play saved recordings
changes: Save the complete MP4 automatically when you stop a recording; Play and Share reuse the saved file.
Preview saved camera recordings on your phone with standard playback controls.
Show video upright using the recording orientation while preserving original camera pixels and calibration.
Preserve full sensor-number precision in MP4 metadata so exported recordings import and replay correctly.

releases.title: Shared measurement core
changes: Run tag distance, height, floor fitting and overlay projection through the shared phone/robot calculation core.
Record the calculation version, source floor and frame age for repeatable measurement analysis.
Keep self-contained MP4 exports compatible with the recording importer and extraction tools.

releases.title: Self-contained MP4 recordings
changes: Share saved sessions as one MP4 containing video, readable YAML metadata, original images and numeric depth.
Keep the camera video clean for later processing; live tag and measurement overlays remain separate from the video.
Extract metadata with stock FFmpeg or restore the original session with the npm recording tools.

releases.title: Thank you to our sponsors
changes: Add a Sponsors shortcut and an About tab recognizing Don Wood Foundation and Medical Informatics Engineering.
Link each sponsor to its official website.

releases.title: April Fools AR by The REFINERY
changes: Introduce The REFINERY icon, colors and branding, with BioNanomics ownership and app identifiers.
Add offline privacy information, the MIT app license and third-party notices under About.
Prepare a standalone Release build for iPad review before Apple account setup and TestFlight distribution.

releases.title: Dotted floor reference squares
changes: Add a small dotted square at the foot of each live tag-height and saved floor-height vector.
Orient the square to the measurement floor: green for level, yellow for tilted and neutral when tilt is unavailable.
Keep floor references attached to their world position through camera movement and zoom, including gravity-leveling mode.

releases.title: Landscape and tablet capture workspace
changes: Use a side-by-side camera and tool rail in iPhone landscape and on roomy iPad windows.
Keep recording controls available while floor and measurement tools scroll beside the camera.
Adapt settings, release notes, bookmarks and saved-session cards to the available screen space.
Keep the camera session and measurements through rotation, with a bounded, scrollable tag debug panel.

releases.title: Distance comparison and floor height tools
changes: Group LiDAR and tag-geometry readings under Distance with aligned numbers for direct comparison.
Show LiDAR delta only above a saved, configurable distance difference threshold; default 15 cm.
Draw each usable tag’s vertical height from the confirmed floor to its center, with the height label midway along the vector.
Show the detected floor tilt and optionally level the measurement floor with gravity while preserving original measurements.

releases.title: Guided floor setup before measuring
changes: Enter Measure through a guided floor scan, with live coverage feedback and an explicit Done confirmation.
Keep refining the selected floor candidate while scanning; freeze the latest plane only after Done.
Require a confirmed floor for manual distance, height and tag-width measurements, and repeat setup after tracking resets.

releases.title: Compact multi-tag camera diagnostics
changes: Show each tag's floor height, LiDAR camera range and tag-geometry camera range together in a small live card.
Use smaller regular-weight text and arrange nearby cards to keep multiple tags readable.
Shrink the default selected-tag panel; keep full pose and raw depth diagnostics under Details.
Retain centimeter formatting and the saved English-units preference.

releases.title: Height units and saved display preference
changes: Show tag and floor heights in centimeters, with feet and inches in parentheses.
Add a saved Show English units preference; switch it off for centimeters only.
Keep recorded geometry in meters and preserve the current calibration when changing display units.

releases.title: Automatic tag height above the floor
changes: Show a live height estimate beside every detected tag ID after selecting the floor once.
Prefer usable LiDAR depth at the detected tag center, with a labeled pose estimate when depth is unavailable.
Keep the source frame, floor reference and height provenance with tag detections; hide heights when their inputs are stale or invalid.

releases.title: Floor planes and persistent 3D measurements
changes: Show detected horizontal surfaces and select a floor for vertical height measurements.
Keep completed distance and floor-height vectors anchored in the scene while moving the phone.
Save measurement geometry and floor provenance with recordings; hide overlays during limited tracking and clear live placement when the AR coordinate frame resets.
Keep AR tag-width measurement separate from completed measurement history.

releases.title: Single-line camera controls
changes: Combine tracking status, depth status and view zoom on one compact line over the camera.
Retain pinch zoom and the 1×, 2× and 4× controls while freeing vertical camera space.

releases.title: Camera view zoom
changes: Pinch to magnify the live view from 1× to 4×, or use the 1×, 2× and 4× buttons.
Keep tag outlines and pose axes aligned, with measurement taps mapped back to the original image.
Keep original camera frames, LiDAR samples and pose calculations unchanged; view zoom does not switch lenses or add optical detail.

releases.title: Build identification and release notes
changes: Show the installed app version, build number, source revision and UTC build date, with release notes available from the header.
Save the version, build, source revision and UTC build date with each new session.
Retain the compact camera overlay, expandable diagnostics and optional tag pose axes.

releases.title: Compact overlay and optional pose axes
changes: Keep the camera preview full size with a translucent compact readout and expandable Details.
Add optional red, green and blue tag pose axes, disabled by default.
Preserve existing measured tag widths when introducing the new preference.

releases.title: Tag pose and LiDAR diagnostics
changes: Show selected-tag camera-relative position, angles, range, reprojection error and matched LiDAR depth comparison.
Add configurable quality thresholds and manual or reviewed AR-measured tag widths.
Preserve measured-width precision when editing other settings.

releases.title: Tag overlay stability
changes: Fix the crash when clearing tag outlines and labels by preserving UIKit-owned views and layers.
Keep recordings and existing capture formats unchanged.

releases.title: Live AprilTag detection
changes: Detect tag36h11 IDs and draw corner outlines while viewing the live camera, independently of recording.
Record frame-linked detections, corner coordinates and decode quality on a bounded native worker.

releases.title: Initial iPhone capture app
changes: Add the native ARKit and LiDAR capture workflow with RGB media, numeric depth, confidence and frame metadata.
Add bookmarks, two-point measurements, saved sessions and ZIP sharing through iOS.
